name: Keystone Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Pennsylvania
what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend government. You live in a mock city and county, hold mock offices, hold meetings and learn how Pennsylvania government works.
who_can_apply: High school girls in Pennsylvania who have finished junior year. You must be a U.S. citizen or legal resident with papers to show it.
pay_detail: No pay. The 2027 form says you send a $100 check to your sponsor and a local Auxiliary unit pays $200. With no sponsor you pay $300. The fee is not refunded.
deadline_text: The 2027 application is posted. It must be postmarked by Apr 30, 2027. Session: June 20 to 25, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the 2027 application form. Add a short bio and a photo. Send it with a $100 check to your local Auxiliary unit, which mails it on. To find a unit or pay the $300 yourself, email kgsalapa@gmail.com.
notes: Girls only. Older site pages conflict: the FAQ is from 2023, the About page says Shippensburg and calls it free in most cases, and the home page shows 20-25 June 2026. The dates and costs here come from the 2027 application.
